title: RL training step
description: Why the training half of an RL step takes as long as it does: the per-rank spans MarinSkyRL publishes from inside the policy worker, the DCGM occupancy of the same nodes, and what the serving engines report. The run-level view is on the RL runs dashboard, which links here.

params.value: SELECT DISTINCT run_id AS value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'policy_step' AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND run_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Why is the training step slow?
policy_ppo_train decomposition at the critical rank
panels.description: Exclusive spans on r* = argmax_rank(policy_ppo_train), the rank the driver blocked on. Never take a per-phase maximum across ranks: barrier and compute are anti-correlated, so the maxima come from different ranks and can sum past the parent. `unattributed` is recomputed here, and signed.

custom.axisLabel: mean seconds per step at r*

defaults.noValue: No worker spans. Set trainer.policy_train_spans=true, and check the telemetry endpoint, run id and execution uid reached the Ray actors — an unconfigured runtime discards every record and still reports a healthy flush.

params.value: WITH spans AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, json_get(attributes_json, 'step') AS s, json_get(attributes_json, 'rank') AS worker_rank, json_get(attributes_json, 'phase') AS phase, json_get(attributes_json, 'parent') AS parent, json_get(attributes_json, 'clock_domain') AS domain, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'role') = 'worker' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ), tagged AS ( SELECT bucket, s, worker_rank, phase, parent, domain, value, FIRST_VALUE(worker_rank) OVER ( PARTITION BY s ORDER BY CASE WHEN phase = 'policy_ppo_train' AND domain IN ('inclusive_wall', 'inclusive_launch') THEN value ELSE -1 END DESC, worker_rank ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING ) AS critical_rank, MAX(CASE WHEN phase = 'policy_ppo_train' AND domain IN ('inclusive_wall', 'inclusive_launch') THEN value END) OVER (PARTITION BY s) AS parent_seconds, SUM(CASE WHEN parent = 'policy_ppo_train' AND domain IN ('exclusive_wall', 'exclusive_launch') AND phase <> 'policy_span_residual' THEN value END) OVER (PARTITION BY s, worker_rank) AS covered_seconds FROM spans ), banded AS ( SELECT bucket, CASE WHEN domain IN ('inclusive_wall', 'inclusive_launch') THEN 'unattributed' ELSE phase END AS band, CASE WHEN domain IN ('inclusive_wall', 'inclusive_launch') THEN parent_seconds - covered_seconds ELSE value END AS seconds FROM tagged WHERE worker_rank = critical_rank AND ((parent = 'policy_ppo_train' AND domain IN ('exclusive_wall', 'exclusive_launch') AND phase <> 'policy_span_residual') OR (domain IN ('inclusive_wall', 'inclusive_launch') AND phase = 'policy_ppo_train')) ) SELECT bucket AS t, band AS series, AVG(seconds) AS value FROM banded GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rank skew: policy_ppo_train across ranks
panels.description: Spread of policy_ppo_train across one step's ranks. The max-to-p50 gap is the straggler skew the driver pays for. Do not subtract it from the driver's policy_train — that waits for the last rank to return, not the longest-running one.

defaults.noValue: No worker spans, so there is no spread. Never a run whose ranks all finished together.

params.value: WITH ppo AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'role') = 'worker' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'phase') = 'policy_ppo_train' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'clock_domain') IN ('inclusive_wall', 'inclusive_launch') AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ) SELECT bucket AS t, MAX(value) AS slowest_rank, approx_percentile_cont(value, 0.95) AS p95, approx_percentile_cont(value, 0.50) AS p50, MIN(value) AS fastest_rank FROM ppo GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: policy_train ÷ micro-step count
panels.description: Driver policy_train per micro-step, with the count itself on the right axis. FSDP pays a parameter all-gather per micro-step, so a flat ratio against a halved count is a real win and an inversely proportional one is not.

defaults.noValue: No policy_train_count rows. The spans and these counters ship together, so this run predates them.

params.value: WITH driver AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, json_get(attributes_json, 'step') AS s, MAX(value) AS seconds FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'role') = 'trainer' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'clock_domain') = 'inclusive_wall' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'phase') = 'policy_train' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2 ), micro AS ( SELECT json_get(attributes_json, 'step') AS s, MAX(value) AS micro_steps FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'policy_train_count' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'counter') = 'micro_step_count' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1 ), joined AS ( SELECT driver.bucket AS bucket, driver.seconds AS seconds, micro.micro_steps AS micro_steps FROM driver JOIN micro ON driver.s = micro.s ) SELECT bucket AS t, AVG(seconds / NULLIF(micro_steps, 0)) AS seconds_per_micro_step, AVG(micro_steps) AS micro_steps FROM joined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: backward ÷ forward at the critical rank
panels.description: The ratio on r*. FSDP2 pays a second all-gather in backward when reshard_after_forward is on and a third for gradient checkpointing, so it climbs above 2:1 when the gathers cost more than the maths. Meaningless across clock domains.

defaults.noValue: No worker spans on r*. Never a forward that took no time.

params.value: WITH spans AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, json_get(attributes_json, 'step') AS s, json_get(attributes_json, 'rank') AS worker_rank, json_get(attributes_json, 'phase') AS phase, json_get(attributes_json, 'clock_domain') AS domain, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'role') = 'worker' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ), tagged AS ( SELECT bucket, s, worker_rank, phase, domain, value, FIRST_VALUE(worker_rank) OVER ( PARTITION BY s ORDER BY CASE WHEN phase = 'policy_ppo_train' AND domain IN ('inclusive_wall', 'inclusive_launch') THEN value ELSE -1 END DESC, worker_rank ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING ) AS critical_rank, MAX(CASE WHEN phase = 'policy_ppo_train' AND domain IN ('inclusive_wall', 'inclusive_launch') THEN value END) OVER (PARTITION BY s) AS parent_seconds FROM spans ), per_step AS ( SELECT bucket, s, MAX(CASE WHEN phase = 'policy_forward' THEN value END) AS forward_seconds, MAX(CASE WHEN phase = 'policy_backward' THEN value END) AS backward_seconds FROM tagged WHERE worker_rank = critical_rank AND domain IN ('exclusive_wall', 'exclusive_launch') GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT bucket AS t, AVG(backward_seconds / NULLIF(forward_seconds, 0)) AS backward_over_forward FROM per_step GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Waiting and collective share at the critical rank
panels.description: The share of policy_ppo_train that r* spent in barriers and collectives. r*'s entry barrier is near zero by construction, so a large share here is real synchronisation cost rather than arrival skew — that belongs to the skew panel.

defaults.noValue: No worker spans on r*. Never a step that spent nothing waiting.

params.value: WITH spans AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, json_get(attributes_json, 'step') AS s, json_get(attributes_json, 'rank') AS worker_rank, json_get(attributes_json, 'phase') AS phase, json_get(attributes_json, 'clock_domain') AS domain, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'role') = 'worker' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ), tagged AS ( SELECT bucket, s, worker_rank, phase, domain, value, FIRST_VALUE(worker_rank) OVER ( PARTITION BY s ORDER BY CASE WHEN phase = 'policy_ppo_train' AND domain IN ('inclusive_wall', 'inclusive_launch') THEN value ELSE -1 END DESC, worker_rank ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING ) AS critical_rank, MAX(CASE WHEN phase = 'policy_ppo_train' AND domain IN ('inclusive_wall', 'inclusive_launch') THEN value END) OVER (PARTITION BY s) AS parent_seconds FROM spans ), per_step AS ( SELECT bucket, s, SUM(CASE WHEN phase IN ('policy_entry_barrier', 'policy_final_barrier', 'policy_metric_allreduce', 'policy_entropy_allreduce') THEN value END) AS waiting_seconds, MAX(parent_seconds) AS total_seconds FROM tagged WHERE worker_rank = critical_rank AND domain IN ('exclusive_wall', 'exclusive_launch') GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT bucket AS t, AVG(COALESCE(waiting_seconds, 0) / NULLIF(total_seconds, 0)) AS waiting_share FROM per_step GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Padding waste and attention work
panels.description: Left: the padding fraction of the trained batch. Right: B·S² ÷ ΣLᵢ², how far eager attention's quadratic cost runs past what the real lengths need. Packing is off for Grug, so the linear padded fraction understates the cost.

defaults.noValue: No token counters. They ship with the spans, so this is an older run — never an unpadded batch.

params.value: WITH counters AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, json_get(attributes_json, 'step') AS s, json_get(attributes_json, 'rank') AS worker_rank, json_get(attributes_json, 'counter') AS counter, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name = 'policy_train_count' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ), per_rank AS ( SELECT bucket, s, worker_rank, MAX(CASE WHEN counter IN ('rank_tokens_real', 'tokens_real') THEN value END) AS tokens_real, MAX(CASE WHEN counter IN ('rank_tokens_padded', 'tokens_padded') THEN value END) AS tokens_padded, MAX(CASE WHEN counter = 'attention_work_ratio' THEN value END) AS attention_work FROM counters GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ) SELECT bucket AS t, AVG(1.0 - tokens_real / NULLIF(tokens_padded, 0)) AS padded_fraction, AVG(attention_work) AS attention_work_ratio FROM per_rank GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Allocator pressure and peak memory on the worst rank
panels.description: Torch's own peak bytes on the rank that used most, with allocator retries on the right axis. A retry means the bytes were there but not contiguous: the leading indicator of an OOM, and invisible in a peak-bytes series alone.

custom.axisLabel: peak bytes on the worst rank

defaults.noValue: No memory counters. They ship with the worker spans, so this run predates them.

params.value: WITH counters AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, json_get(attributes_json, 'step') AS s, json_get(attributes_json, 'rank') AS worker_rank, json_get(attributes_json, 'counter') AS counter, MAX(value) AS value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name IN ('policy_train_bytes', 'policy_train_count') AND json_get(attributes_json, 'role') = 'worker' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) SELECT bucket AS t, MAX(CASE WHEN counter = 'peak_reserved_bytes' THEN value END) AS peak_reserved_bytes, MAX(CASE WHEN counter = 'peak_allocated_bytes' THEN value END) AS peak_allocated_bytes, SUM(CASE WHEN counter = 'alloc_retries' THEN value END) AS alloc_retries, SUM(CASE WHEN counter = 'alloc_ooms' THEN value END) AS alloc_ooms FROM counters GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Were the accelerators doing arithmetic, or waiting?
SM and tensor-pipe activity on this run's nodes
panels.description: DCGM SM-active against tensor-active on this run's nodes. The direct test of whether the eager MoE loop is launch-bound: SM-active stays high while the device does very little, so tensor-active near zero underneath it is the signature. Joined by node, never per rank.

defaults.noValue: No node join: trainer rows carry no node_name, or the node agent is not reporting this cluster. Never idle GPUs.

params.value: WITH gpu AS ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS cl, date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, node_name AS node, json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_uuid') AS gpu_uuid, name, AVG(value) AS rate, MAX(value) AS peak, MIN(value) AS first_value, MAX(value) AS last_value FROM "telemetry_v1.node_agent" WHERE name IN ('gpu_sm_active_ratio', 'gpu_tensor_active_ratio') AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ), run_node AS ( SELECT cl, bucket, node, run FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS cl, date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, node_name AS node, run_id AS run, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin'), date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)), node_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS rn FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE node_name IS NOT NULL AND node_name <> '' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT gpu.bucket AS t, CASE gpu.name WHEN 'gpu_sm_active_ratio' THEN 'SM active' ELSE 'tensor pipe active' END AS series, AVG(gpu.rate) * 100.0 AS value FROM gpu JOIN run_node ON gpu.cl = run_node.cl AND gpu.bucket = run_node.bucket AND gpu.node = run_node.node GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: GPU memory in use on this run's nodes
panels.description: DCGM framebuffer bytes, mean and peak across the run's GPUs. Per device, so it counts everything else on the card — the per-rank torch peaks are the number that decides whether a larger micro-batch fits.

defaults.noValue: No node join. Never “the GPUs used no memory”.

params.value: WITH gpu AS ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS cl, date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, node_name AS node, json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_uuid') AS gpu_uuid, name, AVG(value) AS rate, MAX(value) AS peak, MIN(value) AS first_value, MAX(value) AS last_value FROM "telemetry_v1.node_agent" WHERE name IN ('gpu_memory_used_bytes') AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ), run_node AS ( SELECT cl, bucket, node, run FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS cl, date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, node_name AS node, run_id AS run, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin'), date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)), node_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS rn FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE node_name IS NOT NULL AND node_name <> '' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT gpu.bucket AS t, AVG(gpu.rate) AS mean_used_bytes, MAX(gpu.peak) AS peak_used_bytes FROM gpu JOIN run_node ON gpu.cl = run_node.cl AND gpu.bucket = run_node.bucket AND gpu.node = run_node.node GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: NVLink against PCIe receive traffic
panels.description: DCGM NVLink and PCIe throughput per direction. The proxy for where the FSDP all-gather goes: NVLink is traffic that stayed in the tray, PCIe is what left it. It cannot identify the fabric beyond the host.

defaults.noValue: No node join, or no NVLink/PCIe counters from this cluster's node agent. Never “nothing crossed the fabric”.

params.value: WITH gpu AS ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS cl, date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, node_name AS node, json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_uuid') AS gpu_uuid, name, AVG(value) AS rate, MAX(value) AS peak, MIN(value) AS first_value, MAX(value) AS last_value FROM "telemetry_v1.node_agent" WHERE name IN ('gpu_nvlink_receive_bytes_per_second', 'gpu_pcie_receive_bytes_per_second') AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ), run_node AS ( SELECT cl, bucket, node, run FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS cl, date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, node_name AS node, run_id AS run, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin'), date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)), node_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS rn FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE node_name IS NOT NULL AND node_name <> '' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT gpu.bucket AS t, CASE gpu.name WHEN 'gpu_nvlink_receive_bytes_per_second' THEN 'NVLink receive' ELSE 'PCIe receive' END AS series, SUM(gpu.rate) AS value FROM gpu JOIN run_node ON gpu.cl = run_node.cl AND gpu.bucket = run_node.bucket AND gpu.node = run_node.node GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Link faults and power on this run's GPUs
panels.description: Per GPU: peak board power, and the increase in the NVLink and PCIe error counters with resets discarded. A degraded link shows here as a nonzero increase while throughput on the left stays flat.

defaults.noValue: No GPU increased an NVLink or PCIe error counter here. Empty is the healthy result, unlike every other panel.

params.value: WITH gpu AS ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS cl, date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, node_name AS node, json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_uuid') AS gpu_uuid, name, AVG(value) AS rate, MAX(value) AS peak, MIN(value) AS first_value, MAX(value) AS last_value FROM "telemetry_v1.node_agent" WHERE name IN ('gpu_power_watts', 'gpu_nvlink_errors', 'gpu_pcie_replay_errors') AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ), run_node AS ( SELECT cl, bucket, node, run FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS cl, date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, node_name AS node, run_id AS run, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin'), date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)), node_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS rn FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE node_name IS NOT NULL AND node_name <> '' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) WHERE rn = 1 ), attributed AS ( SELECT gpu.node AS node, gpu.gpu_uuid AS gpu_uuid, gpu.name AS name, MIN(gpu.first_value) AS first_value, MAX(gpu.last_value) AS last_value FROM gpu JOIN run_node ON gpu.cl = run_node.cl AND gpu.bucket = run_node.bucket AND gpu.node = run_node.node GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ) SELECT node AS node, gpu_uuid AS gpu, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'gpu_power_watts' THEN last_value END) AS peak_power_watts, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'gpu_nvlink_errors' THEN last_value - first_value END) AS nvlink_error_increase, MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'gpu_pcie_replay_errors' THEN last_value - first_value END) AS pcie_replay_increase FROM attributed GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN name IN ('gpu_nvlink_errors', 'gpu_pcie_replay_errors') THEN last_value - first_value END) > 0 ORDER BY 4 DESC, 5 DESC

panels.title: Is the engine slow, or is nothing reaching it?
Generated tokens per request
panels.description: Generated tokens per rollout request, as percentiles over the vLLM histogram. The step ends with the slowest sample, so the p99-over-p50 gap is what generation costs it, not the mean.

defaults.noValue: No request_generation_tokens histogram, in either the vllm namespace or the trainer's forwarded one.

params.value: WITH engine AS ( SELECT service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.vllm" WHERE name IN ('request_generation_tokens_bucket') AND service = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) UNION ALL SELECT service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE name IN ('request_generation_tokens_bucket') AND json_get(attributes_json, 'metric_source') = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ), raw AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, json_get(attributes_json, 'le') AS upper_bound, CASE name WHEN 'request_queue_time_seconds_bucket' THEN 'queue' WHEN 'request_prefill_time_seconds_bucket' THEN 'prefill' WHEN 'request_decode_time_seconds_bucket' THEN 'decode' WHEN 'e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket' THEN 'end to end' WHEN 'time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket' THEN 'time to first token' WHEN 'inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket' THEN 'inter-token latency' WHEN 'request_generation_tokens_bucket' THEN 'generated tokens' ELSE 'iteration tokens' END AS family, value, LAG(value) OVER ( PARTITION BY service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json ORDER BY timestamp_ms, seq ) AS previous_value FROM engine ), deltas AS ( SELECT bucket, upper_bound, family, CASE WHEN previous_value IS NULL OR value < previous_value THEN NULL ELSE value - previous_value END AS delta FROM raw ), buckets AS ( SELECT bucket, family, upper_bound, SUM(delta) AS bucket_count FROM deltas WHERE delta IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), ranked AS ( SELECT bucket, family, upper_bound, bucket_count, MAX(bucket_count) OVER (PARTITION BY bucket, family) AS total_count FROM buckets ), quantiles AS ( SELECT bucket, family, MIN(CASE WHEN upper_bound NOT IN ('+Inf', 'Inf') AND bucket_count >= total_count * 0.50 THEN CAST(upper_bound AS DOUBLE) END) AS p50, MIN(CASE WHEN upper_bound NOT IN ('+Inf', 'Inf') AND bucket_count >= total_count * 0.90 THEN CAST(upper_bound AS DOUBLE) END) AS p90, MIN(CASE WHEN upper_bound NOT IN ('+Inf', 'Inf') AND bucket_count >= total_count * 0.99 THEN CAST(upper_bound AS DOUBLE) END) AS p99 FROM ranked WHERE total_count > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2 ), evidence AS ( SELECT bucket, family || ' · p50' AS label, p50 AS observed FROM panels.title: Engine queue depth and why requests are waiting
panels.description: Mean queue depth per engine and the requests held back by each reason, averaged across engines rather than summed. A queue that never fills while the step waits is under-subscription; waiting on KV-cache is the opposite.

defaults.noValue: No queue gauges. These are gauges, so blank is an absent producer and never an empty queue.

params.value: WITH engine AS ( SELECT service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.vllm" WHERE name IN ('queue_depth', 'num_requests_waiting_by_reason') AND service = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) UNION ALL SELECT service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE name IN ('queue_depth', 'num_requests_waiting_by_reason') AND json_get(attributes_json, 'metric_source') = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ), gauges AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, CASE WHEN name = 'queue_depth' THEN 'queue depth' ELSE 'waiting · ' || COALESCE(json_get(attributes_json, 'reason'), 'unknown') END AS label, value FROM engine ) SELECT bucket AS t, label AS series, AVG(value) AS value FROM gauges GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: KV-cache utilisation
panels.description: Mean and peak KV-cache occupancy across the run's engines, a gauge. Read it with the waiting-reason lines: a cache pinned near full while requests wait explains queueing that no amount of extra concurrency will clear, and a cache that stays empty says the engines had room the trainer never used.

defaults.noValue: No KV-cache gauge from this run's engines. Never an empty cache.

params.value: WITH engine AS ( SELECT service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.vllm" WHERE name IN ('kv_cache_usage_perc') AND service = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) UNION ALL SELECT service, run_id, execution_uid, node_name, process_index, name, resource_attributes_json, attributes_json, timestamp_ms, seq, value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE name IN ('kv_cache_usage_perc') AND json_get(attributes_json, 'metric_source') = 'vllm' AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ), gauge AS ( SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS bucket, value FROM engine ) SELECT bucket AS t, AVG(value) AS mean_usage, MAX(value) AS peak_usage FROM gauge GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
